newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: ARA bunkers tumble, rest of Europe follows.
newsitem.headline: ARA bunkers tumble, rest of Europe follows.

text.p: ARA bunkers dropped by around $6 a tonne, falling through the $100 mark for the first time in five months, and the rest of Europe followed albeit in slightly less dramatic fashion, dealers said.

Rotterdam 380 CST was down to around $98/$99 fob as the barge market headed below $95 fob ARA. Dealers said bunker enquiries actually improved from Monday, but the traded volume was still too low to have an impact on the extreme length persisting in the market.
"There are still a lot of people with oil. There seems no way of making people buy," one dealer said.
Hamburg bunkers were around $4 a tonne lower at $112/$113 fob. Shipowners simply waited for further slippage. Suppliers said this was likely as the market caught up with Rotterdam.
Mediterranean prices were $2-$4 a tonne lower than on Monday. In some ports, enquiries improved, but supplies remained plentiful.
"We've had some nice enquiries, but the demand is nothing big and there are good avails," one supplier said.
Fujairah, having dropped below $100 fob on Monday, was offered at around $90.
